comparison.objective: Move two lanyard hooks through three anchors while maintaining continuous attachment; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential hook release, transfer, and reattachment with safety interlock coordination versus hex-key insertion, counterhold, collar rotation, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: At least one hook must remain anchored and both finish released at anchor 3; candidate requires isolated adjustment followed by two safe cycles and no drift.
comparison.reason: Continuous fall-protection attachment and hook transfer are different tested abilities.
